title: Logging and Application Observability knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “Logging and Application Observability”?
options: Integration code must validate external data, handle timeouts and failure states, keep credentials outside source control, and test boundary behavior.

It removes the need to understand types or runtime behavior.
questions.answer_key: Integration code must validate external data, handle timeouts and failure states, keep credentials outside source control, and test boundary behavior.
questions.explanation: The reliable answer is grounded in the lesson’s main principle: Integration code must validate external data, handle timeouts and failure states, keep credentials outside source control, and test boundary behavior. Ignore warnings and suppress failures before identifying the cause.
Assume the compiler or toolchain is broken without reducing the example.
Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
